psychological_meaning: Beaver, a muted brown, evokes feelings of stability, reliability, and earthiness. It is associated with a sense of groundedness and practicality. This color often communicates a sense of comfort, security, and resourcefulness. It can also represent a connection to nature and a quiet strength.
